lines.say: You rent out your body while you sleep. It pays fifty dollars a night.
The app says deliveries. Your body walks the city. You just dream.
Day three. You wake up with sand in your shoes. There is no beach here.
Day seven. You are so tired. People on the street wave at you. You have never met them.
Day eight. A gold ring on your finger. A text. Good morning, husband.
Would you rent out your sleep? Write it in the comments.
